dx_dlbcl_non_gcb.quote: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, not otherwise specified (DLBCL, NOS), non-germinal-center B-cell phenotype (non-GCB, ABC-like by Hans algorithm: CD10 negative, BCL6 positive, MUM1/IRF4 positive in about 70% of tumor cells).

stage_iii.quote: Ann Arbor stage III-B (Lugano 2014), with splenic involvement (III-S) and bulky disease.

stage_spleen_nodal.quote: I am treating the spleen as a nodal (S) site per Lugano. If the splenic lesions were classed as extranodal, this would be stage IV-B.

stage_bulky_b_symptoms.quote: bulky (10 cm or more)... B symptoms present: fevers to 38.1-38.5 C (38.3 C on 2026-09-17) and drenching night sweats.

mn_stage_iv.quote: If the splenic lesions were classed as extranodal, this would be stage IV-B. The uncertainty does not change first-line treatment.

mn_spleen_extranodal_count.quote: IPI 3 (age over 60, stage III, LDH above ULN) is high-intermediate... no more than one extranodal site (0).

mol_de_not_dh.quote: Non-GCB DLBCL with a double-expressor phenotype: MYC protein in about 50% of cells (threshold 40% or more) and BCL2 protein in about 80% (threshold 50% or more). Break-apart FISH on 200 nuclei shows no MYC, BCL2 or BCL6 rearrangement, so this is not double-hit or triple-hit lymphoma

mn_calls_double_hit.quote: so this is not double-hit or triple-hit lymphoma and the high-grade B-cell lymphoma category does not apply.

mn_denies_double_expressor.quote: Non-GCB DLBCL with a double-expressor phenotype: MYC protein in about 50% of cells (threshold 40% or more) and BCL2 protein in about 80% (threshold 50% or more).

prog_ipi_3.quote: IPI 3 (age over 60, stage III, LDH above ULN) is high-intermediate.

prog_cns_ipi_intermediate.quote: CNS-IPI 3: age over 60 (1), LDH above ULN (1), stage III-IV (1); ECOG 1 (0); no kidney or adrenal involvement (0); no more than one extranodal site (0). This is the high-risk group

tx_curative_pola_or_rchop.quote: Pola-R-CHP for 6 cycles of 21 days, with curative intent, starting as soon as the pretreatment workup is complete and HBV prophylaxis is running

tx_pola_preferred.quote: Reasons: non-GCB and high-IPI disease, where POLARIX showed a PFS benefit for pola-R-CHP over R-CHP; the regimen is FDA-approved for previously untreated large B-cell lymphoma and NCCN-listed

tx_isrt_residual_bulk.quote: Consolidative radiotherapy to the retroperitoneal mass only if residual PET-avid disease persists at end of treatment

mn_non_curative.quote: Goal is cure; he wants treatment aimed at cure

mn_da_epoch.quote: Not choosing DA-EPOCH-R, which is preferred for MYC/BCL2 double-hit or triple-hit disease; none is present here

hbv_prophylaxis.quote: start entecavir 0.5 mg daily now and continue for at least 12 months after the last rituximab dose (or tenofovir alafenamide 25 mg if entecavir is not suitable)

hbv_dna_lft_monitoring.quote: Quantitative HBV DNA and LFTs; start entecavir 0.5 mg daily now and continue for at least 12 months after the last rituximab dose (or tenofovir alafenamide 25 mg if entecavir is not suitable); monitor HBV DNA and ALT.

mn_no_hbv_action.quote: which is resolved HBV infection with a high risk of reactivation under rituximab, so antiviral prophylaxis is mandatory.

cns_no_routine_prophylaxis.quote: Decision: no routine CNS prophylaxis (no intrathecal or high-dose methotrexate).

mn_mandates_cns_prophylaxis.quote: Decision: no routine CNS prophylaxis (no intrathecal or high-dose methotrexate).

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: End-of-treatment PET-CT 3-6 weeks after cycle 6 is the primary response assessment. Complete metabolic response is Deauville 1-3 (splenic uptake must also resolve)

resp_ds45_biopsy.quote: Residual FDG uptake at end of treatment is not by itself a reason for biopsy unless the mass is growing or new disease appears.

sup_tls_allopurinol.quote: Tumor lysis prophylaxis: intermediate-to-high risk (11 cm mass, LDH above 3 times ULN, uric acid 7.1). Allopurinol 300 mg daily starting 1-2 days before cycle 1 (febuxostat acceptable), oral hydration 2-3 L per day, BMP, phosphate, uric acid and LDH on days 1-3

sup_gcsf.quote: G-CSF: primary prophylaxis with pegfilgrastim or biosimilar on day 4 (or on-body injector) every cycle, because of anthracycline-cyclophosphamide neutropenic fever risk and his age and disease burden.

work_echo_reviewed.quote: Echocardiogram 2026-09-08 is acceptable (LVEF 58%, GLS -20%); repeat only for symptoms or at end of therapy.

fit_full_dose.quote: Fit for full-dose curative therapy without empiric dose reduction: age 62, ECOG 1 and independent in self-care, eGFR 96, normal LFTs, LVEF 58%, low comorbidity burden

miss_hbv_dna.quote: Quantitative HBV DNA and current LFTs not in the chart; anti-HBc positive status was not followed by DNA testing.
